serverInfo.name: @guardbee/mcp-config-auditor
serverInfo.description: Audits installed MCP client configs and agent SKILL.md files for unpinned packages, secrets, wildcard auto-approve, unauthenticated remote endpoints, typosquats, unrestricted skill tools, and cross-server or cross-skill shadowing.

tools.name: scan_config_text
tools.description: Scan an MCP client config JSON string for unpinned packages, secrets, wildcard auto-approve, unauthenticated remote endpoints, and typosquats.

tools.name: scan_skill_text
tools.description: Scan one agent SKILL.md for unrestricted allowed-tools, instruction override, credential file reads, and literal secrets.

tools.name: scan_file
tools.description: Scan one MCP client config file, or a SKILL.md agent skill when the file has that name.

tools.name: scan_directory
tools.description: Find mcp.json, mcp_config.json, claude_desktop_config.json, and SKILL.md under a directory and audit each one.

exclude.description: Skip paths containing one of these strings

tools.name: scan_inventory
tools.description: Detect cross-server tool shadowing from an inventory of tool catalogs.

inventory.description: JSON inventory of servers and their tools

tools.name: list_patterns
tools.description: List the MCP config, agent skill, and cross-server shadowing checks, with their OWASP MCP Top 10 tags.
